title: Worm-Seed
summary: WORM-SEED, noun 1. A seed which has the property of expelling worms from the stomach, bowels, and intestines. It is said to be brought from Persia, and to be the produce of a species of Artemisia. 2.

inlines.v: WORM-SEED, noun 1. A seed which has the property of expelling worms from the stomach, bowels, and intestines. It is said to be brought from Persia, and to be the produce of a species of Artemisia. 2. A plant of the genus Chenopodium.
